Section 00 — Observation

Twelve lots,
twelve places

Every bag we sell traces back to a slope, an altitude and a week of picking. This is where the coffee in your cup was standing a year ago.

Not a blend. One farm, one harvest, one Thursday on the drum — and gone by the time the next lot lands.

The house shot

Twenty-seven seconds, measured every single time.

From green bean to perfect pour

Eleven years on the same corner. We roast on a 12-kilo drum in the back room every Thursday morning, and whatever comes off it is what you drink that week. When a lot runs out, it is gone — we do not re-order to keep a name on the board.

Direct trade, all twelve lots

Every lot bought from a farm we have visited, at a price we publish on the bag.

Roasted Thursdays, rested nine days

Bags carry a roast date, not a best-before. We will not sell you coffee past four weeks.

Cupping open to the public

Saturdays at ten. Free, no booking, six cups on the table and no wrong answers.

Want to fix your mornings? Let’s brew together!
